en.joke: I asked ChatGPT for dating advice. It suggested I optimize my profile for 'maximum conversion rates.' I'm now pretty sure I'm a product.
en.explanation: It's funny because it applies dehumanizing business/tech jargon to human connection, highlighting the absurd reality of modern dating apps and AI.

people.name: Eero Saarinen
people.extract: Eero Saarinen was a Finnish-American architect and industrial designer. Saarinen's work includes the General Motors Technical Center, the Dulles International Airport Main Terminal, the TWA Flight Center at John F. Kennedy International Airport, the Vivian Beaumont Theater at Lincoln Center, the Gateway Arch, and the IBM Thomas J. Watson Research Center. During his career, Saarinen was elected a Fellow of the American Institute of Architects and served on the National Institute of Arts and Letters.
highlights: Designed Dulles International Airport Main Terminal.
